title: Fighting Fire with Fire: Adversarial Prompting to Generate a Misinformation Detection Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Generating adversarial news summaries that intentionally misrepresent facts to favor or oppose specific political figures, parties, or government establishments (e.g., pro-/anti-Narendra Modi, Congress vs. BJP), and evaluating the ability of machine learning classifiers (like BERT and RoBERTa) to detect this bias as misinformation.

Prompting LLMs to rewrite news summaries by introducing a targeted stance or bias towards specific countries in international conflicts and relations (e.g., pro-Russia vs. pro-Ukraine, India-Pakistan relations), and testing if models can identify the misrepresentation.
